data.display_address: Cavalli Casa Tower, Al Sufouh 2, Al Sufouh, Dubai
data.long_description:
Cavalli Casa Tower captivates with its stunning design, starting with an elegant lobby featuring a covered waterfall and striking light installations. The complex is adorned with an artificial beach and the serene Malibu Bay lagoon, creating a resort-like atmosphere. Residents can maintain a healthy lifestyle with access to a state-of-the-art gym, tennis courts, and a stylish bar. The top floor offers a luxurious recreation area complete with a swimming pool, providing the perfect spot to unwind while enjoying breathtaking views.

Cavalli Casa Tower is a luxury project in Dubai Media City developed by renowned developer Damac Properties. This 75-storey skyscraper stands out due to its luxurious design and the sophistication of designer Roberto Cavalli. Cavalli Casa Tower offers residents luxurious 1-5 bedroom apartments with beautiful views of the city and the Persian Gulf. The complex offers a wide range of modern amenities and uniquely designed interiors in a style typical of the Cavalli brand.

Located in close proximity to the main transportation arteries of Dubai, Cavalli Casa Tower provides residents with easy access to the main objects of social and entertainment infrastructure of Dubai. Within a 5-15 minute radius are the famous Dubai Marina waterfront district and the Burj Al Arab Sail Hotel. In 20 minutes is the Downtown Dubai area with many cafes, restaurants and the famous Dubai Mall, and in about 40 minutes you can reach the world's largest airport - Al Maktoum International Airport.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
